title: Wix
content:
# Wix

Connect a Wix site, then create, schedule, update and delete its blog posts through the Blogs API.

Connect a Wix site and manage its blog posts with the [Blogs API](/blogs/list-blogs). A connected account uses `platform: "wix"` and represents one site with one blog.

## Quick reference

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Platform value | `wix` |
| What it manages | One site's Wix Blog posts through one account-scoped blog (`id: "1"`) |
| Auth | Zernio app installed on the site (no review, no password) |
| Social posting | No |
| Analytics | No |
| Scheduling | Yes, native (`publishDate`; no Zernio queue) |
| Drafts | Yes (`isPublished: false`) |
| Article body | HTML (`bodyHtml`), stored by Wix as rich content |
| Tracking pixels | Yes, page views through the Zernio app ([Tracking pixels](/platforms/wix/tracking-pixels)) |

## Before you start

The site needs the Wix Blog app. The person connecting must be able to install apps on the site.

## Connect

Call `GET /v1/connect/wix` and send the user to the returned `authUrl`. They pick the site in Wix's installer and approve the app. See [Connect](/platforms/wix/connect).
